package.name: racer_drivers
package.description: On-vehicle drivers (claude-docs/02-repo-layout.md). First node: pwm_output_node, the tail of the command path (claude-docs/04-architecture.md). It subscribes to /drive ONLY - never /drive_raw, which would bypass safety_node (CLAUDE.md invariant 1) - and converts steering_angle (rad, left positive) and speed (m/s) into two 50 Hz servo pulses on the Jetson's hardware PWM via the Linux sysfs PWM interface. Those pulses go into the layer-1 mux board (firmware/safety_mux/), which stays physically downstream. Fails closed to the calibrated neutral on startup, on /drive silence, on any exception, and on shutdown. All pulse bounds, angle limits and the speed reference come from config/vehicle_params.yaml via the generated binding; the node refuses to start on a null field. Mapping and output sequencing (include/racer_drivers/) are ROS-free and gtest-unit-tested per claude-docs/12-testing.md L1.
